issue.title: aws_servicecatalog_portfolio search by name, return id
issue.body:
### Description

Currently, the `aws_servicecatalog_portfolio` data source needs the id as an input for the lookup. This seems counter intuitive, as across multiple accounts, the id is unique, where as the name of the portfolio could be identical.

I see this issue was originally logged for this very requirement, https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws/issues/20719, but it was closed without any action.

The AWS cli/api is available to do the lookup via ID.

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

The data source below would be the one which would need enhancement.

```hcl
data "aws_servicecatalog_portfolio" "portfolio" {
  id = "port-xxxxxxx"
}
```

### Potential Terraform Configuration

```hcl
data "aws_servicecatalog_portfolio" "portfolio" {
  name = "Servers"
}

output "portfolio_id" {
  value = data.aws_servicecatalog_portfolio.portfolio.id
}
```
Code copied from issue #20719

### References

We require this as we need to make an association for the portfolio association with a specific IAM role, allowing us to look up the portfolio we need to be able to search for it by name, not by id.

```hcl
resource "aws_servicecatalog_product_portfolio_association" "example" {
  portfolio_id = "port-68656c6c6f"
  product_id   = "prod-dnigbtea24ste"
}
```

As a workaround I have used an aws cli command to do the lookup instead of terraform, but this is not ideal.

```bash
data "external" "portfolio_id" {
  program = ["bash", "-c", <<-EOT
    ID=$(aws servicecatalog list-portfolios \
      --no-paginate \
      --query "PortfolioDetails[?DisplayName=='${var.portfolio_name}'].Id | [0]" \
      --output text)
    echo "{\"id\": \"$ID\"}"
  EOT
  ]
}
```

### Would you like to implement the enhancement?

No
